rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s requests or follow policy. While it looked up the user and orders, it performed order-changing writes (attempted item removal and then canceled the entire order) without first confirming with the user, violating policy. It also appears to have canceled the order even after attempting the item removal, contrary to the user’s conditional instruction. The agent failed to address the skateboard modification or confirm availability, and did not provide the requested total prices for paid grills. The final message was a generic pleasantry with no actionable information or confirmation. These are clear failures under the stated pass criteria.
